title: RenderTarget API, CopyHelper, and render-to-texture example
summary: Adds public RenderTarget framebuffer-style API plus CopyHelper (fullscreen blit helper). New render-to-texture example renders a diffuse-lit cube with normals to offscreen texture, renders cube again onscreen, and overlays texture preview in bottom-left via copy pass.
handoff_message: Antigravity review complete for "render-to-texture". In Cursor, ask the agent to use get_feedback_for_cursor for "render-to-texture".
cursor_notes: Cached CopyHelper bind group by textureView+sampler; no per-frame bind group allocation in steady state.
